title.zh: 【FATF 报告：虚拟资产已成为诈骗园区重要洗钱渠道，呼吁加强跨境追踪与冻结资金】
title.en: 【FATF 报告：虚拟资产已成为诈骗园区重要洗钱渠道，呼吁加强跨境追踪与冻结资金】

current_state.zh: FATF published a report finding that virtual assets have become a key money-laundering channel for scam compounds — including dedicated on-site OTC desks and a wallet cluster that received over $100M in victim funds — and called on countries to integrate asset tracing, freezing and recovery with anti-scam infrastructure and faster cross-border information sharing.
